scope: Native release editor CPU draw path including tick, fixed simulation, extraction, animation, LOD and host submit/present call. Excludes GPU completion timing, event-loop idle and logging.
limits: Single small reference rig, one view, two owners
No before/after release speedup claim; debug log is diagnostic only
No GPU timestamps or CUDA/non-Metal verification
Certificate cache holds one exact palette/world pair per owner; alternating world matrices may miss
CPU certificate storage is not accounted in GPU geometry budget
